description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the JSON encoding/decoding of the OpenClawCanvasSnapshotFormat enumeration within the OpenClawKit framework. It tests whether a JSON string with 'jpg' correctly decodes to the '.jpeg' enum case.

classes.description: A test suite that contains tests for the CanvasSnapshotFormat encoding/decoding.
